propositions: References to removed config keys persist across documentation files, CLI help text, and release notes, creating inaccurate impression that these keys remain configurable.
docs/config.md does not match the pruned schema exactly; removed keys are still listed or documented as live options.
Documentation describing now-hardcoded behaviors incorrectly presents them as configurable toggles rather than fixed behavior.
Grep across docs/, markdown files, and CLI help fixtures reveals active references to removed keys that should only appear in historical migration/changelog records.
CLI help text and golden help fixtures have not been regenerated to reflect the removal of configuration options.
